welcome: A home for all your worlds.
welcomeSub: Create, host and manage Minecraft servers on your computer.
manageServers: Everything your worlds need, in one place.
noServersSub: Choose Paper or Vanilla. MineDock handles Java, downloads and configuration.
noActivity: Your server actions will appear here.
localNoteSub: No cloud account. Installed servers also work offline.
mock: Demo mode — servers, players and metrics are simulated.
desktopOnly: Open MineDock desktop to manage servers. The browser development UI is available with pnpm dev:mock.
createSub: A few settings and your server is ready for players.
paperHelp: Fast, with plugin support. Recommended for playing with friends.
vanillaHelp: The official Minecraft experience, without plugins or mods.
name: Server name
stableOnly: Official releases. Only stable Paper builds are installed.
ramHelp: 4 GB suits a small group on Paper. RAM is a JVM limit; native CPU is unrestricted.
portHelp: Each server needs a unique port. MineDock checks availability.
onlineWarning: Disabling account verification allows impersonation. Keep it enabled on network-accessible servers.
automaticJava: Required Java installed automatically when needed
automaticRcon: RCON enabled with a protected secret
eulaAccept: I have read and accept the Minecraft EULA.
installHelp: Files come from Mojang, PaperMC and Eclipse Adoptium. Integrity is verified before installation.
consoleEmpty: Start the server to see its logs here.
noPlayersSub: Players appear after joining. Moderation commands use RCON.
backupTitle: Keep a copy of your adventures.
backupSub: Local archives, verified with SHA-256. A safety copy precedes every restore.
confirmHelp: Type the exact name below to confirm.
restoreHelp: The server must be stopped. Current files will be replaced after a safety backup.
deleteServerHelp: The server is removed from the list. Its folder is preserved in MineDock’s local trash.
deleteFileHelp: A full server backup precedes file deletion.
scheduleSub: Tasks are persisted in SQLite. MineDock must remain open to execute them.
propertiesHelp: Stop the server before changing settings. A safety backup is created on every save.
worldHelp: Worlds are backed up with the whole server. Change the world folder name in settings to generate a new world on next start.
fileSub: Edit text files up to 2 MB. Stop the server before making changes.
marketplaceSub: Modrinth plugins compatible with your Paper version. Required dependencies install automatically.
vanillaPlugins: Vanilla does not support plugins. Create a Paper server to use the marketplace.
analyticsHelp: Java process measurements, retained for 7 days. CPU can exceed 100% across multiple cores.
noMetrics: Measurements appear after starting the server.
folderHelp: Changing the server folder affects future servers. Existing servers stay in place.
preventSleep: Prevent sleep while a server is running
preventSleepHelp: Temporary inhibition only. No permanent system setting changes.
runtimeHelp: Temurin installs within MineDock without changing your computer’s PATH.
credits: React · Electron · SQLite · Tailwind · Lucide · Adoptium
updatesNote: Signed application updates will be enabled once the release channel is configured.
setupSub: Let’s prepare your computer for your worlds.
setupFinish: Everything is local. You stay in control.
javaAutoHelp: No Java? MineDock will download the right version for your first server.
setupPrivacy: Catalogs and downloads use the Internet. Your worlds and logs stay on your computer.
localAdmin: V1 uses your operating-system account. No remote admin panel is exposed.
activitySub: Local history of operations, errors and backups.
commandHelp: Up / down arrows: history. Sensitive commands use the management buttons.
restartWarning: Scheduled restarts announce a 10-second countdown to players.
localNetworkHelp: Share the network address only within your LAN. Never forward the RCON port to the Internet.
